tagline: 宾得胶片相机，1973 年发布
description: 宾得于1973年推出的胶片相机。配备50 mm f/1.4 or 55 mm f/1.8 SMC Takumar。使用Ratchet type rapid wind lever。

specs.镜头: 50 mm f/1.4 or 55 mm f/1.8 SMC Takumar
specs.取景器: pentaprism and fresnel focusing screen with central microprism focusing aid, 93% coverage
specs.曝光测光: ** CdS-activated TTL meter for open-diaphragm or stopped-down metering.
specs.闪光灯: Hot shoe (synchronised for X-synch. at 1/60 sec) and separate PC sockets beside lens mount for X- and FP-synch.
specs.重量: 678 g (without lens); 930 g with 50 mm f/1.4
specs.英文简介: The Pentax ElectroSpotmatic (ES) II was the most advanced camera of the Spotmatic family.
